A '''line corps''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A line [[Corps/Legends|corps]] was comprised of three [[line battlegroup]]s, a [[reinforced battlegroup]], an [[auxiliary battlegroup]], and [[Corps/Legends#Corps HQs|corps headquarters]]. It included 69,199 personnel, 2,599 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 371 [[Tank|heavy tanks]].<ref name="ISB" />

Line corps could be augmented by the addition of another two line battlegroups, a [[mobile battlegroup]], and an [[armored battlegroup]].<ref name="ISB2" />
